description.ja: 『ガンダムビルドダイバーズ』より、カスタマイズに最適な量産機「GBN-ガードフレーム」が立体化！
description.en: From "Gundam Build Divers ", the mass-produced machine " GBN-Guard Frame", which is ideal for customization, is now in three-dimensional form!

description.ja: • シンプルな構造でありながら広い可動域を確保。
description.en: • Although it has a simple structure, it has a wide range of motion.

description.ja: • 頭部はフルフェイスタイプとキャノピータイプの２種が、青・黒それそれのクリアカラーで付属。
description.en: • Two types of heads are included, a full-face type and a canopy type, in clear colors of blue and black.

description.ja: • バックパックは汎用性の高い、カスタマイズにしやすい構造。
description.en: • The backpack is highly versatile and has a structure that is easy to customize.
